How is Lovart different from tools like Midjourney or Canva?

While standard generators produce random single images, Lovart is an AI Design Agent. It uses MCoT to reason through your client brief, generating entire cohesive brand kits on an interactive ChatCanvas with professional editing tools like layer splitting.
Can I legally sell the designs I create for my clients?
Absolutely. If you are on any of our paid plans (Starter, Basic, Pro, Ultimate), you receive full commercial rights to everything you generate, making it 100% safe to hand over to clients.
How does Lovart help me handle client revisions?

Lovart features Touch Edit and Edit Elements. You don't need Photoshop to fix a small detail. Click on any object to swap it out, or split the image into layers to non-destructively alter the background or text.
Can it generate readable text for posters and ads?

Yes. Powered by models like Seedream 4.5, Lovart's Text Edit tool understands structured typography. You can generate perfectly readable copy and edit it directly on the canvas without visual artifacts.
What formats can I export my work in?
You can export your final deliverables in high-resolution PNG, JPG, SVG for vector assets, and layered PSDs to integrate perfectly into your existing professional workflow.
